lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a staggered grid pattern with highest spatial density in the mid-lateral zone, exhibiting larger centroids (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) transitioning to smaller clusters towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a geometric grid. These intersections serve as primary anchor nodes across the central flank between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient featuring a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-luminance shadow immediately ventral to the crest.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 18-22 discrete high-luminance blobs. The distribution shows higher density and larger cluster sizes near the base of the fin, with smaller, more sparse spots towards the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots (low diameter, high luminance) that are significantly more concentrated and less structured than the grid pattern observed on the primary lateral flank.
